description: Publish the staged AgentJido self-portrait as one independent DelveTown post, not as a reply, quote, or thread child. Require action-time operator confirmation and the existing write guard. Reuse the tested blob-upload and record-publication path. Persist the draft ID, artifact digest, blob receipt, post URI, post CID, publication time, and idempotency key. Acceptance: one approved action creates one remote post; a retry returns the prior result and creates no duplicate; the saved record proves which local draft produced the remote post; the caption clearly says that the image is AgentJido self-portrait and does not present it as a human photograph.
title: Publish one AgentJido self-portrait as a top-level post
